embedding of

  • CURIE: gmeow:embeddingOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/embeddingOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/graphrag

The information object this embedding represents. Functional: one embedding represents exactly one object under one model.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Embedding -> gmeow:InformationObject; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:embeddingOf from gmeow:Embedding to gmeow:InformationObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
